3. Model Formulation and Fitted Coefficients

Objective Convention: min_{beta0, beta} (1 / (2*n)) * ||y - beta0 - X*beta||_2^2 + alpha * ||beta||_1 (intercept beta0 unpenalized)
Selected Penalty (α): 0.00028057 (grid [0.0002806, 2.806], 60 points)

6. Algorithm-Specific Interpretation

  • On the held-out test split (n=301), the model achieves R²=0.5583 and RMSE=4.704 dB (compared to Train R²=0.5034, Train RMSE=4.827 dB).
  • Largest standardized predictor effects in absolute magnitude: frequency (-4.059), chord-length (-3.219), attack-angle (-2.366).
  • Training-only KFold(5, shuffle=True, seed=42) selected alpha=0.0002806 (CV RMSE=4.861 dB, CV R²=0.4927), converging in 32 coordinate-descent iterations.
  • Lasso retained 5 of 5 predictors and set 0 exactly to zero (0.0% sparsity), shrinking the L1 norm from 12.99 (OLS) to 12.99 (ratio=0.9998).

7. Limitations and Potential Assumption Violations

  • Linear models assume additive linear relationships between standardized predictors and the conditional target mean; nonlinear interactions require basis expansion or nonlinear models.
